dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: Actually, there's a lot of interesting stuff I can tell you about Sorush.

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: Though, I can't just whisper them to you behind her back... Ah. There will be opportunities to talk about her in the future!

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: Please come visit me more with Sorush!
